title: Taiwanese Association of America Las Vegas 拉斯維加斯 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America Las Vegas (TAALV, 拉斯維加斯 台灣同鄉會) is the Las Vegas, Nevada chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter connects Taiwanese Americans and Taiwanese-heritage residents in the greater Las Vegas area and operates as part of the TAA’s Western region network.
